```{r}
set_colors <- function(data_MA_plot, color_scale) {
  data_MA_plot <- data_MA_plot |>
    # Sort to put selection on top
    mutate(to_color = factor(to_color,
      levels = names(color_scale)
    )) |>
    arrange(to_color)

  # Sort to keep this order of selected genes for the plot
  data_MA_plot <- data_MA_plot |>
    mutate(gene_symbol = factor(gene_symbol, levels = data_MA_plot$gene_symbol))
  return(data_MA_plot)
}
get_top_hits <- function(data_MA_plot, selection = "baseMean") {
  # label top selected genes
  top_hits_FC <- data_MA_plot |>
    filter(selection_siRNA & padj < 0.1) |>
    arrange(desc(log2FoldChange)) |>
    head(10)
  top_hits_baseMean <- data_MA_plot |>
    filter(selection_siRNA & padj < 0.1) |>
    arrange(desc(baseMean)) |>
    head(10)
  top_hits_padj <- data_MA_plot |>
    filter(selection_siRNA & padj < 0.1) |>
    arrange(padj) |>
    head(10)
  if (selection == "baseMean") {
    return(bind_rows(top_hits_FC, top_hits_baseMean) |> distinct())
  } else {
    return(bind_rows(top_hits_FC, top_hits_padj) |> distinct())
  }
}
```


```{r}
volcano_plot <- function(df, x_name, to_label, color_scale, x_max = NA) {
  if (is.na(x_max)) {
    # symmetric x axis
    x_max <- max(abs(df$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE)
    df <- mutate(df, shape = "")
  } else {
    df <- mutate(df,
      shape = ifelse(log2FoldChange > x_max, "> max", ""),
      log2FoldChange = ifelse(log2FoldChange > x_max, x_max, log2FoldChange)
    )
  }
  # label top 10 selected genes

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
    geom_point(aes(color = to_color, shape = shape)) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = to_label,
      aes(
        x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj),
        label = gene_symbol
      )
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-x_max, x_max), name = x_name) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_scale, na.value = "grey80") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(color = NULL, y = "-log10(FDR)")
  return(p)
}
MA_plot <- function(df, y_name, to_label, color_scale, y_max = NA) {
  if (is.na(y_max)) {
    # symmetric y axis
    y_max <- max(abs(df$log2FoldChange), na.rm = TRUE)
    df <- mutate(df, shape = "")
  } else {
    df <- mutate(df,
      shape = ifelse(log2FoldChange > y_max, "> max", ""),
      log2FoldChange = ifelse(log2FoldChange > y_max, y_max, log2FoldChange)
    )
  }
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2(baseMean), y = log2FoldChange)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = to_color, shape = shape)) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = to_label,
      aes(
        x = log2(baseMean), y = log2FoldChange,
        label = gene_symbol
      )
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey", linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-y_max, y_max), name = y_name) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_scale, na.value = "grey80") +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    labs(x = "log2(mean gene expression)", color = NULL)
  return(p)
}
```

```{r fig.height=6/2.54, fig.width=6/2.54}
data_MA_plot <- DEGs |>
  # Keep metabolic genes
  filter(is_metabolic) |>
  # Specify significant metabolic genes
  mutate(is_significant = padj_Factor1 < 0.1) |>
  mutate(to_color = case_when(
    selection_siRNA ~ "selected",
    !is_significant ~ "FDR > 0.1",
    is_significant & !is_elevated_patient ~ "FDR < 0.1, not elevated in patients",
    is_significant & is_elevated_patient ~ "FDR < 0.1"
  )) |>
  set_colors(color_scale = color_scale_FDR_factor) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    log2FoldChange = log2FoldChange_Factor1,
    padj = padj_Factor1,
    baseMean = baseMean_Factor1
  )

top_hits <- get_top_hits(data_MA_plot, selection = "baseMean")
top_hits$gene_symbol

figure_3b <- data_MA_plot |>
  MA_plot(
    y_name = "coefficient Factor 1",
    to_label = top_hits,
    color_scale = color_scale_FDR_factor
  )
figure_3b

top_hits <- get_top_hits(data_MA_plot, selection = "padj")
top_hits$gene_symbol

figure_3c <- data_MA_plot |>
  volcano_plot(
    x_name = "coefficient Factor 1",
    to_label = top_hits,
    color_scale = color_scale_FDR_factor
  )
figure_3c
```

### Figure 3DE

```{r fig.height=6/2.54, fig.width=6/2.54}
data_MA_plot <- DEGs |>
  # Keep metabolic genes
  filter(is_metabolic) |>
  # Specify significant metabolic genes
  mutate(is_significant = (padj_Subtype < 0.1 & abs(log2FoldChange_Subtype) > 1)) |>
  mutate(to_color = case_when(
    selection_siRNA ~ "selected",
    !is_significant ~ "FDR > 0.1",
    is_significant & !is_elevated_patient ~ "FDR < 0.1, abs(log2FC) > 1, not elevated in patients",
    is_significant & is_elevated_patient ~ "FDR < 0.1, abs(log2FC) > 1"
  )) |>
  set_colors(color_scale = color_scale_FDR_subtype) |>
  dplyr::rename(
    log2FoldChange = log2FoldChange_Subtype,
    padj = padj_Subtype,
    baseMean = baseMean_Subtype
  )

top_hits <- get_top_hits(data_MA_plot, selection = "baseMean")
top_hits$gene_symbol

figure_3d <- data_MA_plot |>
  MA_plot(
    y_name = "log2 FC (Basal B/luminal)",
    to_label = top_hits, color_scale = color_scale_FDR_subtype, y_max = 10
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
figure_3d

top_hits <- get_top_hits(data_MA_plot, selection = "padj")
top_hits$gene_symbol

figure_3e <- data_MA_plot |>
  volcano_plot(x_name = "log2 FC (Basal B/luminal)", to_label = top_hits, color_scale = color_scale_FDR_subtype, x_max = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
figure_3e
```


```{r}
subtype_legend <- get_legend(figure_3d, position = "bottom", n_row = 1)
ggdraw(subtype_legend)
```
